newsitem.title: USA: DHS Industries says unit profit on track.
newsitem.headline: DHS Industries says unit profit on track.

text.p: DHS Industries Inc on Tuesday said its unit, DHS Research, is on track to meet company 1996 projections to generate a net profit for the year of $125,000 on sales of $500,000.
Through the first three quarters ended September 30, the unit posted net income of $66,033 on revenues of $403,559.

"The company feels DHS Research is more than on target to meet projections of $500,000 in revenues for 1996 with a profit of $125,000," Douglas Phillips, president, said in a statement. He added the unit intends to make three to five acquisitions in the next 12 months.
DHS Research is a marketing research firm that specializes in focus groups.
